title: Seoul stocks slide over 3% on profit-taking amid persistent AI woes
caption:
South Korean markets saw a sharp decline today as investors cashed in on chip stocks. Concerns over the profitability of massive AI investments are fueling the sell-off.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul stocks slide over 3% on profit-taking amid persistent AI woes
